subject: Cognitive Science
title: The Testing Effect
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Testing Effect usable.

hook.text: Students who took practice tests scored 50% higher than those who reread the same material four times.

buildup.text: The testing effect: retrieving information from memory strengthens it far more than restudying does.

discovery.text: Each retrieval attempt reorganizes and reconsolidates the memory, creating new pathways to access it.

twist.text: Even failed retrieval attempts help. The struggle to recall primes the brain to encode the answer better.

climax.text: Flashcards, practice quizzes, and self-testing are all free, powerful tools most students underuse.

punchline.text: Testing isn't just measurement. It's learning.

quiz.question: Why is the testing effect powerful?
options: Retrieval strengthens memory more than restudying
